Edge cases  —  acceptance harness for the Trickster Graphite provider (todo 1.7)

panels.description: Relative time override of 12h. Whisper selects ONE archive per query from the age of `from`, so this entire series comes from the 60s rung even though the last 6h are stored at 10s. Compare with the 'Requests per 10s' panel above at a 6h range.
panels.title: Archive boundary: dev.fast over 12h (whole query served at 60s; newest 6h exist at 10s)

panels.description: Relative time override of 120d against a 5m:90d ladder. Graphite clamps `from` to now-maxRetention; the first 30 days of the panel are empty by design.
panels.title: Beyond maxRetention: dev.coarse from -120d (clamped to 90d)

panels.description: The files were created with 30s:12h,5m:14d,1h:1y while storage-schemas.conf declares 60s:2d,5m:30d,1h:2y. Any step prediction that trusts the static config is wrong here: the observed step at a 1h range is 30s, not 60s.
panels.title: Schema drift: dev.drift.* (storage-schemas.conf says 60s, disk says 30s)

panels.description: movingAverage needs lookback beyond the requested range; highestMax selects series based on the whole range. Neither is range-decomposable, so neither may be delta-cached.
panels.title: Not allowlisted (D4): movingAverage + highestMax → must fall back to OPC

panels.description: Two targets in one /render call that resolve to different steps (10s and 60s at this range). A single TimeRangeQuery.Step cannot describe this request.
panels.title: Multi-target, different ladders (D5): dev.fast + dev.medium in one render
Trickster — graphite1 provider (panels fill in by phase; see todo Phase 3.5)

panels.description: Every request Trickster handles for graphite1, by routed path. Live since Phase 2 (proxy-only). Path becomes /render, /metrics/find, ... once 7.8 registers per-endpoint paths.
panels.title: Frontend requests by path & status (live: Phase 2)

panels.description: End-to-end latency as seen by Grafana. Live since Phase 2. Should drop once DPC hits serve from cache (Phase 7).
panels.title: Frontend latency p50 / p99 (live: Phase 2)

panels.description:
Cache lookup outcome per request once /render routes through the Delta Proxy Cache (hit, phit, rmiss, kmiss, rhit) or the Object Proxy Cache / proxy-only fallback lane. The plain proxy handler does not emit this family, so it is empty until Phase 7.

Empty before its phase is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: DPC / OPC outcomes by cache_status (Phase 7)

panels.description:
hit+phit+rhit over all cache-classified requests for graphite1.

Empty before its phase is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Cache hit ratio — graphite1 (Phase 7)

panels.description:
Data points returned to clients from the DPC path, by lookup status.

panels.title: Returned data points by cache_status (Phase 7)

panels.description:
Average time Trickster spends fetching from the Graphite origin, emitted by the cache engines.

panels.description:
get/set/delete operations on graphite1's dedicated cache. Dedicated so that no other backend's traffic lands here.

Empty before its phase is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Cache operations — graphite_fs (Phase 7)

panels.description: Bytes and objects in graphite1's dedicated filesystem cache (the memory provider exports no usage gauges, which is why the dev env uses filesystem here). Per design note §7 / D7 the same metric is cached once per rung it is queried at, so storage grows with distinct (target, step) pairs, not with distinct targets.
panels.title: Cache storage — graphite_fs (Phase 7)

panels.description:
Eviction events on graphite1's cache, by reason.

Empty before its phase is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Cache evictions — graphite_fs (Phase 7)

panels.description:
trickster_graphite_resolution_lookups_total by confidence: exact | derived | configured | unknown (label values frozen in todo 3.4). Expected steady state: almost everything exact; unknown only for the D4 edge panel's targets; the drift namespace must land in exact (via probe), never configured.

The metric family itself ships in Phase 9 (the behavior it observes lands earlier). Empty before then is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Resolution confidence breakdown (Phase 9)

panels.description:
kind: narrow | wide | find. result: step | empty | error. The probe rate must spike at cold start and collapse toward zero while the ladder count flattens at a handful (4 for this environment). If probing never quiets, the registry is not converging.

The metric family itself ships in Phase 9 (the behavior it observes lands earlier). Empty before then is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Probe rate by kind/result + distinct ladders (Phase 9)

panels.description:
layer: leaf | ladder | target | negative. leaf is the large cheap map (24 here), ladder the small one (4), target the short-TTL expansion cache, negative the unknown-verdict backoff entries.

The metric family itself ships in Phase 9 (the behavior it observes lands earlier). Empty before then is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Registry entries by layer (Phase 9)

panels.description:
Why a /render request was routed to the unaccelerated lane. reason values are frozen in todo 3.4. The D4 edge panel should show function_not_allowlisted; the D5 panel multi_target_step_mismatch (until 12.3); nothing else should appear in steady state.

The metric family itself ships in Phase 9 (the behavior it observes lands earlier). Empty before then is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Fallback reasons (Phase 9)

panels.description:
A predicted step that disagreed with the step the origin actually returned. Any non-zero value is a bug in resolution prediction (design note §8: never return incorrect data). Empty (no series) before Phase 7; zero thereafter.

The metric family itself ships in Phase 9 (the behavior it observes lands earlier). Empty before then is EXPECTED and is the acceptance criterion for that phase. Do not edit this panel to make it non-empty; land the phase that emits the metric.
panels.title: Step mispredictions — MUST stay flat at zero (Phase 9)
